t: You're standing on York Terrace, a street of grand terraces overlooking the south side of Regent's Park in Marylebone. York Terrace West is Grade I listed, and so are numbers one to eighteen of York Terrace East, while the rest of the east side is Grade II. Two women died in houses here. One was Mary Moore, Lady Wyndham, an English actress and theatre manager, who acted for decades opposite Charles Wyndham and married him in 1916. The other was Blanche Fitzroy, who lived from 1839 to 1933.
